value.rationale: The direction of a magnetically guided microswimmer can occasionally reverse; the rate and waiting-time distribution quantify orientation reliability beyond the source's spatial-target approximations. Shrinking the antiparallel acceptance angle at the physically selected scale of inverse square-root field strength changes the escape-time prefactor from a standard fixed-cap Laplace law to an exponential-integral profile. Its next correction and full exponential normalized law yield a concrete precision prediction for magnetic orientation reversal; the result is not an arbitrary finite example or a simple parameter rename.
